questions.stem: A 49-year-old patient who has been posted for kidney transplantation has been prescribed the drug Basiliximab as a prophylaxis for acute organ transplant rejection. This drug is a monoclonal antibody against:
questions.solutionHtml:
IL-2 receptor

B- Selective IL-2 Receptor Antagonists Basiliximab & Daclizumab

  • Basiliximab is a chimeric antibody composed of 25% murine & 75% human protein. Block IL
  • Daclizumab is humanized antibody composed of 90% human protein
  • Therapeutic Use:
  • Prophylaxis against acute rejection of kidney transplantation
  • > Used in combination with steroids or CSA
  • Basiliximab & Daclizumab are IL-2 receptor antagonists used in prophylaxis for acute organ transplant rejection. Organ transplant is a condition that should be managed with immunosuppression. Rituximab is a CD 20 inhibitor.

questions.stem: A 39-year-old male with Rheumatoid arthritis has been prescribed the drug Cyclosporine. He may develop the following adverse effects from this drug:
questions.solutionHtml:
Hypotension

Cyclosporine causes hypertension as an adverse effect (Not hypotension). The mechanism of action of cyclosporine is calcineurin inhibition.

questions.stem: A 49-year-old patient diagnosed with Rheumatoid arthritis has been prescribed the drug Infliximab. This drug is a monoclonal antibody against:
questions.solutionHtml:
TNFα

Infliximab, Adalimumab, Certolizumab & Golimumab are monoclonal antibodies against TNF α. TNF alpha is the main cytokine involved in many inflammatory reactions- hence, an effective anti-TNF alpha therapy is mandatory for treatment.



Goodman & Gilman's The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 647, 652, Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 937, 943

questions.stem: A 32-year-old male with bronchial asthma came to the OPD with severe dyspnea. Laboratory investigation showed severe eosinophilia. The doctor wants to prescribe him a monoclonal antibody against IL-5. Which of the following monoclonal antibody can be prescribed to this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Mepolizumab
  • IL-5 plays a pivotal role in eosinophilic inflammation & is also involved in eosinophil survival & priming.
  • Anti–IL-5 & anti–IL-5 receptor (IL-5Rα) antibodies inhibit eosinophilic inflammation & airway hyperresponsiveness in patients with mild asthma.
  • Mepolizumab is an anti–IL-5 antibody that has now been FDA-approved for use in highly selected patients with severe asthma. Raslizumab is another antibody that acts by a similar mechanism.


Goodman & Gilman's The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 647, 742, Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 943
